newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U seeks Swedish approval for Tolterodine.
newsitem.headline: P&U seeks Swedish approval for Tolterodine.

text.p: Swedish-U.S. pharmaceutical company Pharmacia & Upjohn said on Wednesday it had applied for registration of incontinence drug Detrusitol, or Tolterodine, in Sweden.
Pharmacia & Upjohn will also file an application for Tolterodine in the U.S. shortly, the company said in a statement.
In the EU, Sweden is the reference member state with regard to the licensing of Detrusitol and the application in Sweden is an important step toward approval across Europe, the company said.
Tolterodine is a new drug for treatment of urinary urge incontinence, the company said.
